svg.title: The shared Commit and NewHeight schedule
svg.desc: Commit processing and the remaining NewHeight wait use a shared schedule. Compare local means on the validator and two observers; do not treat them as two independent removable timers.

g.text: At entry to Commit, CometBFT schedules the next height. Application work uses part of that interval.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202f36

g.text: NewHeight records the remaining wait. A longer Commit can therefore leave a shorter NewHeight.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #58686f

g.text: These are pooled means, not paired per-block traces. Live timeout settings were not retrieved.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #58686f

g.text: Snapshot 0 has incomplete phase coverage. Removing Commit plus the whole timer would double-count time.
